source: read-only inspection of the running V4 container at /vllm-workspace
notes: SchedulerOutput is a Python dataclass; there is no stable C struct offset for it.
The POC identifies a batch by the identity of the SchedulerOutput.num_scheduled_tokens dict.
The type name is read from the owner object to reject unrelated dict lookups.
A new dict pointer closes the previous batch and opens a new one; the final open batch is closed at the last observed event or the live map last_seen timestamp.
This is not a function-level execute_model boundary and must not be described as one.
